forecasting.name: Cash Forecasting
forecasting.blurb: Three modules lift forecast accuracy to 100%. Fewer nasty volume shocks.
levels: Module 1: forecast accuracy 40% to 60%. Surprises shrink a little.
Module 2: forecast accuracy 60% to 80%. The shocks get smaller.
Module 3: forecast accuracy 80% to 100%. No volume surprises left.
forecasting.hedjLine: In real life, Hedj turns messy cash forecasts into numbers you can hedge against.

visibility.name: Cash Visibility
visibility.blurb: One use: finds 3% of starting cash hiding in forgotten bank accounts.
visibility.hedjLine: In real life, Hedj puts every bank balance in one place, so idle cash stops hiding.

facilities.name: Bigger Bank Facilities
facilities.blurb: Hedge up to 100%, not 50%, plus a borrowing cushion of 10% of starting cash.
facilities.hedjLine: In real life, Hedj helps you secure bigger bank facilities as your business outgrows them.

hedgeAccess.name: Rate & Commodity Hedging
hedgeAccess.blurb: Many banks won't offer it. Now you can hedge interest-rate and commodity exposures.
hedgeAccess.hedjLine: In real life, Hedj gives you interest-rate and commodity hedging many banks won't offer.
